text:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to deploy svc-auth v2.3 to prod in Wed noon window (12:15-12:30 PT). Need smoke + rollback readiness. Who can own the rollout?

deploy-bot: CI ✅ pipeline #789 finished. Artifacts: svc-auth:v2.3 (sha: a1b2c3).

Nina: I can own smoke + rollback. I'll be on the thread and on-call at 12:10 PT. Will run smoke script and watch traces.

Ben: quick Q — are there any DB migrations or schema changes?

Alex: No DB migrations. Just a config flag (token_ttl) default change. No data migration.

Ben: cool. smoke command I'll run locally first:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh svc-auth https://auth.redwood.ai/health 100
# expects 200 for all requests, prints latency percentiles
```
and a quick curl check: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://auth.redwood.ai/health`

Priya: I'll own observability during rollout. Plan: canary 10% for 10m, then 50% for 5m, then 100% if green. I'll watch error rate, 5xx, and p95 latency. :eyes:

Alex: Canary plan confirmed: 10%/10m -> 50%/5m -> 100%. Rollback plan: flip feature flag off + run Jenkins rollback job to tag svc-auth:v2.2. Ops knobs are ready.

Ben: PR #512 merged (code review done). Tagging ops-jen to sanity-check infra settings.

ops-jen: LB drain timeout checked (60s). Healthcheck interval set to 10s. I validated HPA scale target; no infra changes required. Can trigger LB failover or route rollback if needed. :thumbsup:

Nina: Starting smoke in ~3m from now. I'll post quick results.

Nina: Smoke update: 100 requests, all 200s. p50=35ms p95=112ms. No errors in traces for token endpoints. No abnormal DB connections. Proceeding to ramp to 50% canary in 2m.

Priya: watching logs/alerts. No errors, traces look clean, no regression in downstream calls.

Alex: thanks everyone. tagging pagerduty for visibility @pagerduty-bot — please notify if any SLOs cross thresholds.

pagerduty-bot: No active alerts in the last 15m. No on-call escalations.

Nina: Ramp to 50% done. Monitoring for 10m window. Will rollback immediately if error rate > 0.5% or any spike in p95.

Alex: If rollout stays clean after 15m at 50%, we’ll do 100% and close this rollout. Keep posting short updates here. Thanks!
